in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p21-f0.claim: The 1906 census recorded 33,267 occupied houses and 10,633 unoccupied houses in Bombay.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p21-f0.quote: According' to the census of 1906, there were 33,267 occupied houses and 10,633 unoccupied houses in Bombay*

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p17-f0.claim: The site chosen in 1902 for the magnetic branch of the observatory is at Alibag on the coast of the mainland.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p17-f0.quote: The site, which was finally chosen in 1902, is at Alibag on the coast of the mainland, about 18 miles south-east of Bombay.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p18-f1.claim: The bank shares had a quotation of Rs. 1,500 per share in 1909.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p18-f1.quote: With a steady increase in dividends and regular additions to the reserve fund, the value of Bank shares has been gradually enhanced, the. present (1909) quotation being Rs. 1,500 per share.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p1-f1.claim: A Gujarathi girls' school was opened in the Fort in 1859 by the Trustees of the Gokuldas Tejpal Charities.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p1-f1.quote: a Gujarathi girls’ school, opened in the Fort in 1859 by the Trustees of the Gokuldas Tcjpal Charities, to which all Gujarathi-speabing Hindu girls are '.admitted free of charge.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p9-f1.claim: Due to line expansion, the company moved its workshops from Byculla to Parel in 1878.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p9-f1.quote: In course of. time the expansion of the line forced the company to look for a larger area and in 1878 a move was made from Byculla to the present workshops at Parel.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p2-f1.claim: Mr. Clow arrived in India as the first Church of Scotland Chaplain in Bombay two years later.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p2-f1.quote: Two years later Mr. Clow, the first Church of Scotland Chaplain in Bombay, reached India, and in 1816 the foundations of St. Andrew's Church were laid between what was then the Court House and the Ramparts.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p21-f1.claim: Mahim, Varli, and Sion contained the largest number of primitive type huts.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p21-f1.quote: Mahim, Varli and Sion contain the largest number of huts of a primitive type.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p19-f0.claim: Colaba is divided into Upper and Lower Colaba by an imaginary line drawn at the north wall of St. John's Memorial Church.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p19-f0.quote: is divided into Upper and Lower Colaba by an imaginary line drawn across the land at the north wall of St. John's Memorial Church.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p3-f2.claim: The total number of the Christian community of the church is 631.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p3-f2.quote: The total num^r of the Christian community of the church is 631.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p15-f0.claim: The Vereadores estimated the total damage at Rs. 14,330, but the Committee of Accounts reduced it to Rs. 8,500, a sum sanctioned by the Government.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p15-f0.quote: The Vereadores calculated the total damage at Rs. 14,330, but the Committee of Accounts reduced this estimate to Rs. 8,500, which amount was sanctioned by Government.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p14-f0.claim: Messrs. George Smith and Sons initiated a monthly line of sailing ships to Bombay in 1863.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p14-f0.quote: In 1863 Messrs. Georg^e Smith and Sons started a monthly line of sailing ships to Bombay, and sixteen of these vessels reached Bombay via the Cape in 1878.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p12-f1.claim: By 1820 the Society had opened four schools for natives on the island, which were attended by about 250 pupils.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p12-f1.quote: by 1820 the Society had opened four schools for natives in the island, attended by about 250 pupils.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p20-f0.claim: The chapel of Mount Carmel was erected in the year 1721.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p20-f0.quote: The chapel of Mount Carmel, was erected in 1721.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p12-f0.claim: The Society for promoting the education of the poor within the Government of Bombay was founded in 1815 and is now known as the Bombay Education Society.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p13-f0.claim: The 2-anna silver piece was introduced in the year 1841.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p13-f0.quote: In 1841 the 2-anna silver piece was introduced, and in the same year a proclamation was issued regulating the gold coinage.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p0-f1.claim: In 1735 Bombay had a wind mill for grinding wheat on the Esplanade, which had disappeared by 1808.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p0-f1.quote: In 1735 Bombay contained a wind mill for the grinding of wheat situated on the Esplanade ; but this had dis- appeared by 1808.

in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p7-f1.claim: The Grant Medical College was founded in 1845.
in.ernet.dli.2015.35213-p7-f1.quote: The Board also received control of the Grant Medical College, founded in 1845.

in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p0-f2.claim: In 1909 Bombay had four large flour mills: the Bombay Flour Mill, the Union Mill, a mill on Mount Road, Mazagon, and the Wallace Flour Mill.
in.ernet.dli.2015.96511-p0-f2.quote: At the present date (1909) Bombay contiuns 4 large flour mills, vis., the Bombay Flour Mill,* the Union Mill, a Mill in Mount Road, Mazagon, and the Wallace Flour Mill.
